project_name: Bihar State Highways Project and Additional Financing
land_acquisition_note: ADB PCR: no land acquisition was required (rehabilitation within existing right-of-way). Delay instead caused by local insurgency and 2 of 9 contractors' poor performance. Resettlement of 1,553 non-titled households (down from 1,984 at appraisal) via encroacher/squatter R&R, not land acquisition.

ADB PCR explicitly cites 'limited availability of encumbrance-free land in some sections exacerbated the delays'; one 60.81km road package dropped entirely because land acquisition was not completed. Category A (significant) involuntary resettlement: 17.516 ha acquired from 579 titleholders, 2,289 non-titleholders affected. LA/R&R/utility-shifting cost ran 12% over budget ($16.3m appraisal to $18.5m actual).
